variation: Unassisted Nordic hamstring curl through a controlled partial range, ankles secured with a fixed padded strap. Straight torso and thighs, arms crossed, slow eccentric and hamstring-led return.
camera: Fixed side three-quarter view facing right, showing knee pad, both ankle restraints and body line.
equipment: Thick knee pad and anchored padded ankle strap on a rigid low floor platform; no partner.

beats.label: Anchor and brace
beats.cue: Secure ankles; cross arms and brace straight.
beats.pose: Upright kneeling, hips extended, shins supported, ankles secured.

beats.label: Lean forward slowly
beats.cue: Lean forward from your knees, staying straight.
beats.pose: Straight torso/thigh line tilts forward approximately25degrees from upright, knees/ankles fixed.

beats.label: Control your range
beats.cue: Lower only as far as you control.
beats.pose: Straight torso/thigh line tilts about45degrees, no hip hinge; controlled partial range.

beats.label: Keep tension
beats.cue: Keep hips extended and hamstrings under tension.

beats.label: Pull back upright
beats.cue: Use your hamstrings to pull yourself back.

beats.label: Reset tall
beats.cue: Return upright without bending at your hips.
